title: Identification of the published tensor comparison for one inverse image
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, and any scheme morphism f:X→Y. Let d_f be publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f. Use the systemClosed structures and systemTensorModel models of pullbackTensorCalculus to construct the ambient tensor comparison on the sequence site. For every M,N in coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y, d_f(T_Y(M,N));mu_ambient(f)(M,N) = mu_published(f)(M,N);T_X(d_f(M),d_f(N)). This identifies the two comparisons for one morphism, without a composition claim. proof.text: Use the representative normalization theorem to identify the transported ambient tensor comparison with the unique pullback tensor system comparison. The theorem applies on flat K-flat representatives and the existing uniqueness construction extends this equality to the comparison isomorphisms.

Apply the categorical transport cancellation lemma to the equality of comparison isomorphisms. Evaluating at (M,N), the inverse-image isomorphism cancels against the product inverse and yields exactly the displayed component equation.

proof_origin.place: Representative normalization and categorical transport cancellation in the proof of the tensor pullback comparison.

theorem publishedSystemTensorIdentification {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y) :
    (WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app
        ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
      ((publishedSystemAmbientData l E).tensor f).hom.app (M, N) =
    (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (M, N) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app M)
          ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app N))
